name: Dirzuga Reinforcements
text:
When you produce units:Place this card face up in your play area and place a Dirzuga token on a non-home planet other than Mecatol Rex that has a unit you control with PRODUCTION, or at least 3 infantry you control. Planets that contain Dirzuga tokens have their planet's resources value increased by 2 and their influence value increased by 1. Ditzuga tokens cannot be removed from the planets that contain them 
At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Arborec Diaspora player.

name: Cortical Backup
text:
ACTION: Place this card in your play area.
During your tactical actions, you may treat non-fighter neutral ships as if they were your own.
At the end of one of your tactical actions in which you moved neutral units or activated a system that contains 1 or more of the H4L1R's player's units, return this card to the H4L1R player.

name: Mental Clarity
text: After another player moves ships into a system that contains your units; you may reveal this card and choose ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, SPACE CANNON, BOMBARDMENT, SUSTAIN DAMAGE or PRODUCTION. Other players cannot use that unit ability in this system this turn. At the end of the turn, return this card to the Neurovoid player.

name: Indulgent representation
text:
After you activate a system, Place this card face up in your play area. While this card is in your play area, you are not an outlaw. Return a decree to the Archon player and return their command tokens from your faction sheet.
At the end of your turn, return this card to the Archon player.

name: Eramina Elixer
text: When you would research a technology; You may spend a strategy token to gain 1 random genome. Then return this card to the Moyin player.

name: Covert Channel
text:
At any time during the action phase: you may discard any number of action cards. For each action card discarded, you gain 1 commodity. Then, convert all commodities to trade goods.
At the end of this turn, return this card to the Veilstrike player.

name: Eyes of the Watcher
text:
When another player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your ships and 1 or more planets you control:For each adjacent system, you may move one of your non-fighter ships in that system into the active system.
Then, return this card to the Convocation player.

name: Weaveway Fabricators
text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home, non-legendary planet you control. This system contains a nebula. At the start of the status phase, if a player has ships in this system, they may place 1 cruiser from their reinforcements in this system.

name: Weaveway Spinners
text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home, non-legendary planet you control. This system contains a nebula. At the start of the status phase, if a player has ships in this system, they may gain 2 trade goods.

name: Weaveway Harvesters
text: ACTION: Attach this card to a non-home, non-legendary planet you control. This system contains a nebula. At the start of the status phase, if a player has ships in this system, they may draw 1 action card.

name: Authorization Warrant
text: When you receive this card, if you are not the Keleres Player, you must place it face up in your play area. At the end of the status phase, draw 1 secret objective, place it face up in your play area, then return this card to the Keleres player.

name: Defensive Escorts
text: At the start of combat, place this card face up in your play area. When 1 of your ships in this system would be destroyed during combat, you may choose 1 Company player's ship in an adjacent system with SUSTAIN DAMAGE to become damaged instead. At the end of combat, return this card to the Company player.

name: Contract Rider
text: After an agenda is revealed: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, resolve the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks. Then, return this card to the Jord player.
